value: Suspected Dream Market main administrator Owe Martin Andresen arrested in Germany on 2026-05-07 on German money-laundering charges in a coordinated German and US operation; the US indictment alleges he laundered the marketplace's dormant commission wallets (DEA, 2026-05-13).

SentinelOne post (2026-05-15) on CI/CD subversion seen in 2025: a TeamCity intrusion, a GitLab service-account token used to run Ansible playbooks, and Contagious Interview and Sha1-Hulud rogue runners.

Unauthenticated settings write in FunnelKit Funnel Builder for WooCommerce Checkout before 3.15.0.3 (CVE-2026-47100), exploited to plant fake Google Tag Manager card skimmers; FunnelKit saw 3 of more than 1,300 monitored sites compromised (Sansec, 2026-05).

Kimsuky toolkit evolution documented by Kaspersky GReAT (May 2026): the Rust-based HelloDoor variant of PebbleDash alongside httpMalice, MemLoad, httpTroy, AppleSeed and HappyDoor, with TryCloudflare quick-tunnel and VS Code remote-tunnel C2; South Korea is the main target, and PebbleDash victims include a German defense firm.

7-Eleven confirms unauthorized access on 2026-04-08 to systems storing franchisee documents (about 50 people in three US state filings) after ShinyHunters claimed more than 600,000 Salesforce records.
Data exfiltration at ARWINI, Lower Saxony's statutory-prescription audit body, confirmed by the Hannover police directorate, which names the Kairos group.
Three CVEs in BigBlueButton bbb-web (sessionToken handling, checksum bypass, SSRF) in the open-source virtual classroom.

Grafana Labs GitHub breach through a workflow token missed in the rotation after the TanStack npm compromise: code and internal repositories with business contacts were downloaded, CoinbaseCartel claimed it, and Grafana refused the ransom.

Commodity malware-as-a-service native IIS module backdoor ('demo.pdb' BadIIS, installed under globalModules and modules) documented by Cisco Talos, likely shared among Chinese-speaking crime groups; Talos contrasts it with DragonRank and UAT-8099 without linking them.

Nuclear-simulation sabotage operation documented by Symantec and Carbon Black: an LS-DYNA and AUTODYN hook engine targeting a 30 g/cm3 density threshold; Kim Zetter argues it was contemporaneous with Stuxnet, while Broadcom still calls it pre-Stuxnet.

Operation Ramz (October 2025 to February 2026), which INTERPOL calls the first cyber operation of its scale it coordinated in the MENA region: 201 arrests across 13 countries and 53 servers seized, including a phishing-as-a-service website dismantled in Algeria.

entity.summary: Data-theft extortion group active since September 2025 that lists victims on its leak site without encrypting files; security firms link it to ShinyHunters, Scattered Spider and Lapsus$, which ShinyHunters denies (SecurityWeek; BleepingComputer, 2026-05-18).

rel.note: claimed on its leak site; Grafana names no extorter
